afrobeat-city-lights.title: City Lights Dance
afrobeat-city-lights.lyrics:
[Verse]
The traffic hums a low melody
My people out in the avenue
Forget the stress of the company
We got a vibe that is overdue
Park the car by the corner shop
Lace the boots for the long way
Once we start we will never stop
Turning the night into yesterday

[Chorus]
Under the yellow glow
Moving my body slow
Dancing all night
Dancing all night
Watch how the energy grow
Feel it from head to toe
Dancing all night
Dancing all night

[Verse]
The asphalt’s holding the midday heat
Steam is rising up off the ground
No more shoes on these tired feet
Laughter making a joyful sound
Pass the bottle and share a glass
Light reflecting in every eye
Watching all of the strangers pass
High as the birds in the purple sky

[Chorus]
Under the yellow glow
Moving my body slow
Dancing all night
Dancing all night
Watch how the energy grow
Feel it from head to toe
Dancing all night
Dancing all night

[Bridge]
Morning is coming but we don't care
The moon is still hanging above the square
Tell the DJ to play it loud
Lose yourself in the happy crowd

[Chorus]
Under the yellow glow
Moving my body slow
Dancing all night
Dancing all night
Watch how the energy grow
Feel it from head to toe
Dancing all night
Dancing all night

[Outro]

country-dirt-road.title: Dirt Road Home
country-dirt-road.lyrics:
[Verse]
The asphalt ends where the tall pines lean
Left the interstate for a shade of green
Dust starts kicking up behind the tires
Passing cattle guards and rusted wires

[Verse]
That old oak tree still guards the creek
Found the quiet place I came to seek
Windows down to catch the summer air
Smell of mown hay everywhere

[Chorus]
Coming home to the red clay ground
Slow it down for a one-stop town
Everything stays just the same
Coming home to the red clay ground
Going back where they know my name

[Verse]
Grandpa’s tractor’s parked beside the shed
Sun is dipping low and turning red
The water tower stands against the blue
Counting miles until the barn’s in view

[Chorus]
Coming home to the red clay ground
Slow it down for a one-stop town
Everything stays just the same
Coming home to the red clay ground
Going back where they know my name

[Outro]
Just a dirt road mile to go
Driving slow
Driving slow

[Outro]

hiphop-city.title: City Never Sleeps
hiphop-city.lyrics:
[Verse]
Two A.M. and the train is mostly ghosts
Head against the glass, counting every single post
I got a pocket full of maps and a heart full of doubt
But I’m too far in to find the easy way out
Coffee gone cold while the moon turns gray
Just another dollar and a dream in the way
They told me pack it up, go back to the start
But they don’t see the engine pumping deep inside my heart

[Chorus]
Sleep is for the lucky, I’m just tryna win
Do it all today then I do it all again
I’m never giving up
I’m never giving up
Watch the skyline burning while the world stays still
If the pressure don’t get me then the hunger surely will
I’m never giving up
I’m never giving up

[Verse]
Stairs smelling like rain and some cheap takeout
This is what the magazines don’t talk about
The landlord’s knocking and the check didn’t clear
But the vision in my head is getting crystal clear
I’m outworkin’ everyone who’s tucked in tight
Found a little magic in the middle of the night
My sneakers are thin but my spirit is thick
I’m building up the kingdom, brick by heavy brick

[Chorus]
Sleep is for the lucky, I’m just tryna win
Do it all today then I do it all again
I’m never giving up
I’m never giving up
Watch the skyline burning while the world stays still
If the pressure don’t get me then the hunger surely will
I’m never giving up
I’m never giving up

[Bridge]
They see the diamond, they don't see the coal
They don't see the hours that it took to find a soul
I’m tired of the waiting, I’m tired of the "no"
I’m planting every seed just to watch the garden grow

[Chorus]
Sleep is for the lucky, I’m just tryna win
Do it all today then I do it all again
I’m never giving up
I’m never giving up
Watch the skyline burning while the world stays still
If the pressure don’t get me then the hunger surely will
I’m never giving up
I’m never giving up

[Outro]

pop-bonfire.title: Summer Bonfire Love
pop-bonfire.lyrics:
[Verse]
The wood was stacked up high
Against a deep blue sky
We sat on driftwood logs
And watched the sparks go by
You had that old guitar
Strumming under every star
I knew right then and there
We wouldn't go too far

[Chorus]
Salt in the air
Smoke in your hair
Summer started with a spark
Dancing in the dark
Sand on our feet
The night felt so sweet
Summer started with a spark
Dancing in the dark

[Verse]
The tide was coming in
Cool water on our skin
We shared a plastic cup
And let the stories begin
Nobody checked the time
Leaving everything behind
Just the glow of the red
And the things we never said

[Chorus]
Salt in the air
Smoke in your hair
Summer started with a spark
Dancing in the dark
Sand on our feet
The night felt so sweet
Summer started with a spark
Dancing in the dark

[Bridge]
Morning light was far away
We didn't want to see the day
Just keep the embers burning bright
Stay inside this orange light

[Chorus]
Salt in the air
Smoke in your hair
Summer started with a spark
Dancing in the dark
Sand on our feet
The night felt so sweet
Summer started with a spark
Dancing in the dark

[Outro]

rnb-late-night.title: Can't Stop Thinking
rnb-late-night.lyrics:
[Verse]
Two AM and the clock just stopped
Watching the rain in a single drop
I’m leaning back with the phone pressed tight
Just your voice in the middle of the night
We’re talking circles 'bout where we’ve been
Tracing the places we’re living in
I try to act like I’m keeping my cool
But I’m breaking every single rule

[Chorus]
I can't get you off my mind
No matter how hard I try
I’m losing sleep tonight
I can't get you off my mind
Thinking 'bout you and I
It happens every time
I can't get you off my mind
Yeah, I can't get you off my mind

[Verse]
You laugh a little and the room goes warm
I’m safe right here in the quiet storm
You’re telling stories I’ve heard before
But I’m still wanting to hear some more
The coffee’s cold and the candle’s low
But I don’t ever want to let you go
It’s getting late but I’m wide awake
Giving more than I’m meant to take

[Chorus]
I can't get you off my mind
No matter how hard I try
I’m losing sleep tonight
I can't get you off my mind
Thinking 'bout you and I
It happens every time
I can't get you off my mind
Yeah, I can't get you off my mind

[Bridge]
Maybe it’s the way the moonlight hits the floor
Or how I’m always wanting something more
I should hang up and close my eyes
But I’m caught up in these blue-black skies
Just one more minute, just one more word
The sweetest thing that I’ve ever heard

[Chorus]
I can't get you off my mind
No matter how hard I try
I’m losing sleep tonight
I can't get you off my mind
Thinking 'bout you and I
It happens every time
I can't get you off my mind
Yeah, I can't get you off my mind

[Outro]

rock-starting-over.title: Clock Out Forever
rock-starting-over.lyrics:
[Verse]
The fluorescent lights are humming a dirge
Counting every minute till the five o’clock surge
I’ve got ten years buried in a cubicle grave
Just a cog in a machine that I don't want to save
Coffee’s gone cold and the water’s gone stale
The ink is drying up on a story so pale
I’m packing up the pictures and the lucky pen
I’m never coming back to this cage again

[Chorus]
Cut the ties and let it burn
This is the point of no return
I’m walking out the door
I don’t work here anymore
Living for a Friday is a heavy debt
The sun hasn't even started setting yet
I’m walking out the door
I don’t work here anymore

[Verse]
Got a tank full of gas and a map in the seat
Leaving all the gray for the open heat
They told me I was lucky just to have a chair
But I’d rather starve in the mountain air
No more fake smiles or the corporate talk
I’m taking off the tie and I’m starting to walk
The boss can keep the bonus and the desk by the wall
I’m trading in the safety for the thrill of the fall

[Chorus]
Cut the ties and let it burn
This is the point of no return
I’m walking out the door
I don’t work here anymore
Living for a Friday is a heavy debt
The sun hasn't even started setting yet
I’m walking out the door
I don’t work here anymore

[Bridge]
Maybe I’ll fail or maybe I’ll fly
But I won't spend my life just waiting to die
The rearview mirror shows the ghost of a man
I’m tearing up the blueprint and I’m changing the plan

[Chorus]
Cut the ties and let it burn
This is the point of no return
I’m walking out the door
I don’t work here anymore
Living for a Friday is a heavy debt
The sun hasn't even started setting yet
I’m walking out the door
I don’t work here anymore

[Outro]
